主要内容: On February 21, 2014, Novavax, Inc. entered into an amendment to its Prime Contract with the Department of Health and Human Services, Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (HHS BARDA). The amendment extended the base period of performance under the Prime Contract to September 23, 2014. The remainder of the Prime Contract remains unchanged. The amendment was announced in a press release issued on February 27, 2014. The amendment will be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission as an exhibit to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2013. The amendment is related to the Company’s biotechnology operations and may impact its industry activities and financial reporting obligations.

股票实体.名称: Department of Health and Human Services, Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (HHS BARDA)
